name: Generate images of NODDI
summary: Generates PNGs of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of the NODDI NDI, ODI and ISOVF maps with FSL slicer, for quick QA of a NODDI fit.
description: Runs FSL slicer -a on the NDI, ODI and ISOVF maps of the NODDI datatype and writes one PNG per map to raw/. Use it to check a NODDI fit or make figures; it does not modify the data.

inputs.description: NODDI datatype; the NDI, ODI and ISOVF maps are rendered.

outputs.description: Directory with ndi.png, odi.png and isovf.png.
